lines.en: label halloween3:
scene street_noon
I wind up releasing myself from the custody of my [niece] and her friends shortly after we leave the mall.
lines.zh: 离开商场没多久，我总算从[niece]和她的朋友们手里把自己赎了出来。

lines.en: Not wanting to head back to the house to watch Ami make her costume, I decide to go for a walk around town instead.
lines.zh: 我不想回家看 Ami 做她的装扮，于是决定改在城里走走。

lines.en: I’m not really sure what time Sara and Haruka were expecting me to come over tonight, so I guess I just have to kill time until whenever that is.
lines.zh: 我不太确定 Sara 和 Haruka 希望我今晚几点过去，所以我想我只能先消磨时间，直到那个时候。

lines.en: And what better way to kill time than scavenging the city for other girls I know?
lines.zh: 而消磨时间最好的办法，莫过于满城搜寻我认识的其他女孩了。

lines.en: I mean, sure, Kumon-mi is a pretty big place- but I always manage to run into one of the like, twenty people I know somehow or another.
lines.zh: 我承认，Kumon-mi 是个挺大的地方——但我认识的人也就那么二十来个，而我总能莫名其妙地撞上其中一个。

lines.en: I’m sure something convenient like that is bound to happen again at any moment.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，这种凑巧的事随时都会再次发生。

lines.en: : Woah! What a crazy coincidence! Sensei is here!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！好巧啊！Sensei 在这儿！

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro1
I turn around to find Rin and Futaba eating lunch at the bistro Ami and Maya like to hang out at.
lines.zh: 我转过身，发现 Rin 和 Futaba 正在那家 Ami 和 Maya 爱去的小餐馆里吃午饭。

lines.en: It’s not normal that I find anyone here on the weekend since this place is between the dorms and the[school], but I guess there’s no limit on when people are allowed to eat.
lines.zh: 周末在这里碰见人其实并不常见，因为这地方在宿舍和[school]之间，不过我想人什么时候吃饭也没什么限制。

lines.en: : Hey. What are you two up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你们两个在干什么？

lines.en: : What’s it look like we’re up to? We’re having lunch.
lines.zh: : 看着像在干什么？我们在吃午饭啊。

lines.en: : Would you care to join us, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 要不要一起，Sensei？

lines.en: : Oh, no. I actually just ate at the mall with Ami and some of the others.
lines.zh: : 哦，不了。我刚和 Ami 还有几个其他人在商场吃过了。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro2
: Oh, you were with them, too?
lines.zh: : 哦，你刚才也跟她们在一起？

lines.en: : I texted Sana a little while ago to see if she wanted to come with us but she said she was busy.
lines.zh: : 我不久前给 Sana 发消息问她要不要一起来，但她说她有事。

lines.en: : You two have been together the whole day then, I’m assuming?
lines.zh: : 那我猜你们两个一整天都在一起？

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro3
: Right. We just finished putting our costumes together for the Halloween party tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 对。我们刚把明天万圣节派对的装扮弄好。

lines.en: : Putting together as in...making them?
lines.zh: : 弄好……是指自己做吗？

lines.en: : That’s right!
lines.zh: : 没错！

lines.en: : Why is everyone suddenly making their own costumes? Whatever happened to buying stuff?
lines.zh: : 为什么大家突然都开始自己做装扮了？买现成的不好吗？

lines.en: : Well, we’re actually wearing costumes that...we wore to some other event last year but-
lines.zh: : 其实我们穿的是……去年参加另一个活动时穿过的装扮，只是——

lines.en: : Our sizes have, umm, kind of changed...so we were adjusting them.
lines.zh: : 我们的尺寸，嗯……有点变化了……所以我们在改。

lines.en: : I have boobs now! It’s sweet!
lines.zh: : 我现在有胸了！超棒的！

lines.en: : Yes, Rin. That is very sweet.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Rin。确实很棒。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro4
: And I...have somehow grown in that department as well.
lines.zh: : 而我……在那方面也不知怎么地长大了些。

lines.en: : Wack.
lines.zh: : 离谱。

lines.en: : At this rate, those things are gonna take over Kumon-mi one day.
lines.zh: : 照这个速度，总有一天那玩意儿会占领整个 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I’ll defend the city.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我会保卫这座城市。

lines.en: : I don’t know what you plan on doing exactly, but I don’t think the city will need actual defending any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你具体打算怎么做，但我觉得这座城市短期内还不需要真正的保卫。

lines.en: : Sure. But when it does.
lines.zh: : 当然。但真到那一天的时候。

lines.en: : ...Thank you for the support.
lines.zh: : ……谢谢你的支持。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro2
: Are you going to be dressing up, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei 你也要打扮吗？

lines.en: : Do I look like the type to dress up?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像是会打扮的那种人吗？

lines.en: : No, you look like a total buzzkill.
lines.zh: : 不像，你看起来就是个十足的扫兴鬼。

lines.en: : Correct. I am a total buzzkill and will only be coming to see how everyone else is dressed up.
lines.zh: : 没错。我就是个十足的扫兴鬼，去也只是为了看看别人打扮成什么样。

lines.en: : I’d probably never hear the end of it from any of you if I actually wore a costume.
lines.zh: : 我要是真穿了装扮，大概会被你们念叨到死。

lines.en: : So you’re going to come to a party with a bunch of [teenage]girls in costumes and just stare at them all night dressed as a normal dude?
lines.zh: : 所以你是要来一场派对，身边全是一群穿着装扮的[teenage]女孩，而你就穿得像个普通大叔，整晚盯着她们看？

lines.en: : That’s the plan.
lines.zh: : 就是这个计划。

lines.en: : Yeah, that checks out. Have fun.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很符合你的风格。玩得开心。

lines.en: : I’ll do my best.
lines.zh: : 我尽力。

lines.en: : Friend!
lines.zh: : 朋友！

lines.en: An unmistakable voice cries out from not-far-behind me and, before I know it, the owner of said voice joins us at the table.
lines.zh: 一个绝不会认错的声音从我不远处后方喊了出来，还没等我反应过来，那声音的主人就已经加入了我们这桌。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro5
: I appeared at this large wooden circle to check on the guests, but I am now more excited to be seeing you instead!
lines.zh: : 我出现在这个巨大的木制圆形旁边是为了查看客人，但现在能看到你，让我更兴奋！

lines.en: : Welcome back! Will you be consuming hot meat today?
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来！今天要享用热肉吗？

lines.en: : Thanks, Kaori, but I just ate a little while ago.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Kaori，不过我刚才吃过了。

lines.en: : I understand! Please inform me if the wisdom juices in your brain begin to flow differently and cause you hunger.
lines.zh: : 我明白！如果你脑中的智慧汁液开始以不同的方式流动并让你感到饥饿，请告诉我。

lines.en: : I will...be sure to do that.
lines.zh: : 我……一定会告诉你的。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro6
: When did...you and Kaori get so close? Didn’t she call you something like Hamburger Man the last time we saw her?
lines.zh: : 你和 Kaori 是什么时候……变得这么熟的？上次见到她的时候，她不是还管你叫汉堡人之类的吗？

lines.en: : Hamburger Man?...
lines.zh: : 汉堡人？……

lines.en: : It’s a long story and probably not worth telling.
lines.zh: : 说来话长，大概也不值得讲。

lines.en: : The name “Friend” seems like a pretty big jump. How many steps are there between...food and friends, exactly?
lines.zh: : 从“汉堡人”跳到“朋友”，跨度可真够大的。食物和朋友之间……到底隔着几步？

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro7
: One!
lines.zh: : 一步！

lines.en: : Which is also the amount of friends I possess now!
lines.zh: : 这同时也正是我现在拥有的朋友数量！

lines.en: : All I need is an animal companion and my quest for eternal joy will be complete!
lines.zh: : 我只需要一个动物伙伴，我的永恒喜悦之旅就圆满了！

lines.en: : Yeah, after our first date, Kaori warmed up to me very quickly.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我们第一次约会之后，Kaori 很快就跟我熟起来了。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro8
: Y-You went on a d-d-d-date with Kaori?!
lines.zh: : 你——你和 Kaori 约——约——约会了？！

lines.en: : And I wasn’t invited?!
lines.zh: : 而我居然没被邀请？！

lines.en: : Sensei...Are you and this girl...
lines.zh: : Sensei……你和这个女孩……

lines.en: : Why must you speak misleading words to this pair of [young]females?!
lines.zh: : 为何你要对这一对[young]女性说出如此误导的话语？！

lines.en: : What did I do wrong? You invited me on a date to the diner, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 我做错什么了？不是你邀请我去那家餐厅约会的吗？

lines.en: : Before I knew what the meaning of a human-date was!
lines.zh: : 那是在我弄清楚人类约会是什么意思之前！

lines.en: : It was a human date, too?!
lines.zh: : 那还真是人类意义上的约会？！

lines.en: : What else would it even be, Rin?
lines.zh: : 不然还能是什么，Rin？

lines.en: : I don’t know but I’m still jealous!
lines.zh: : 我不知道，但我还是很嫉妒！

lines.en: : Uhh...like I was asking, are you and this girl perhaps...in a relationship, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 呃……就像我刚才问的，你和这个女孩是不是……在交往，Sensei？

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro9
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Oh.
: ...Pardon?
lines.zh: : ……你说什么？

lines.en: : We are in a relationship.
lines.zh: : 我们在交往。

lines.en: : Kaori, I don’t think that’s what Futaba means.
lines.zh: : Kaori，我觉得 Futaba 不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Silence, Friend. I may not be advanced in terms of conversation yet, but even I understand the meaning of the word “relationship.”
lines.zh: : 安静，朋友。我或许还不擅长交谈，但就连我也明白“关系”这个词的意思。

lines.en: : Do you really, though?
lines.zh: : 你真的明白吗？

lines.en: : Umm...could you maybe explain what...type of relationship the two of you have?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你能不能解释一下你们两个是……什么类型的关系？……

lines.en: : All I will tell you is that it involves a lot of meat.
lines.zh: : 我只能告诉你，那和很多肉有关。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro10
: How far have you two gone in such a short amount of time?!
lines.zh: : 你们两个在这么短的时间里已经进展到什么地步了？！

lines.en: : A lot of...meat?! Then...that means-
lines.zh: : 很多……肉？！那……也就是说——

lines.en: : Only I can handle this man’s meat.
lines.zh: : 只有我能处理这个男人的肉。

lines.en: : If you attempt to challenge me, you will be destroyed.
lines.zh: : 如果你胆敢挑战我，你会被摧毁。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro11
: OH GOD I’VE MISSED SO MUCH!
lines.zh: : 天哪，我错过了好多！

lines.en: : S-Sensei! Does she really...h-h-h-h-handle your...meat?...
lines.zh: : S——Sensei！她真的……处……处……处理你的……肉吗？……

lines.en: : And if she does then...w-w-w-why is she so...up-front about it?!
lines.zh: : 如果真有，那……她为……为什么这么……直言不讳？！

lines.en: : Go on, Friend! Explain to the stripey-girl how quickly the hot meat comes when I am the one handling it.
lines.zh: : 说吧，朋友！跟那个条纹女孩解释一下，由我来处理的时候，热肉来得有多快。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro12
: Wow! Is it, uhh...getting kind of hot out here? It is, right? So hot...Hahaha...hah...
lines.zh: : 哇！是不是，呃……这里有点变热了？是吧？好热啊……哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : Friend! Explain the circumstances!
lines.zh: : 朋友！解释一下情况！

lines.en: : On second thought, why don’t you just show them, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 转念一想，Kaori，你干脆直接展示给她们看怎么样？

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro13
: Show us?! R-Right now?!
lines.zh: : 展示？！就……就现在？！

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro14
: YES. RIGHT NOW.
lines.zh: : 好。就现在。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro15
: Oh. Umm...
: Sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : Got a little carried away there.
lines.zh: : 有点上头了。

lines.en: : I’m good now.
lines.zh: : 我现在没事了。

lines.en: : I’m...surprised by how open you are to this, Rin...
lines.zh: : 我……很惊讶你居然这么放得开，Rin……

lines.en: : Open to what? I’m just hanging out and eating sushi with my best friend, my teacher, and one of the hottest girls in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 放得开什么？我只是和我最好的朋友、我的老师，还有全 Kumon-mi 最辣的女孩之一一起吃寿司而已。

lines.en: : I mean Kaori. Who I am totally not attracted to.
lines.zh: : 我是说 Kaori。我对她完全没感觉。

lines.en: : Unless she wants me to be.
lines.zh: : 除非她希望我有。

lines.en: : In that case, I totally am.
lines.zh: : 如果是那样的话，我绝对有。

lines.en: : I know not what this talk of attraction is, but I will now make the necessary preparations for the meat.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你们说的吸引力是什么，但我现在要为肉做必要的准备了。

lines.en: : I will return in roughly one human-minute.
lines.zh: : 大约一个人类分钟后我就回来。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro16
Kaori gets up and basically sprints away from the table, disappearing into the kitchen.
lines.zh: Kaori 站起身，几乎是冲刺着离开了桌子，消失在厨房里。

lines.en: A series of extremely loud noises follows as she...makes the necessary preparations...
lines.zh: 紧接着传来一连串极其响亮的声音，因为她正在……做必要的准备……

lines.en: : Sensei...I don’t know if I’m comfortable watching this...
lines.zh: : Sensei……我不知道自己看着这个会不会觉得别扭……

lines.en: : Especially...outside...
lines.zh: : 尤其是……在外面……

lines.en: : Umm, okay. So, I’m obviously not experienced in this department, but...what preparations need to be made, exactly?
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧。我在这方面显然没什么经验，但是……到底需要做什么准备？

lines.en: : I thought it was as simple as just kinda...you know, tugging it a little. And stuff.
lines.zh: : 我以为就是简单地……你知道的，稍微撸一撸。之类的。

lines.en: : Also, is it okay if I take my phone out for this? Just for research, obviously.
lines.zh: : 还有，我可以把手机拿出来吗？当然只是为了研究。

lines.en: You know, as...difficult as Kaori is to understand at times, I’m glad she’s able to create moments like this.
lines.zh: 虽然 Kaori 有时候确实很难理解，但我很庆幸她能制造出这样的场面。

lines.en: One simple misunderstanding has lead me to discovering that one of my students wants to film me receiving a handjob-
lines.zh: 一个简单的误会，让我发现自己的一个学生想拍下我被手淫的样子——

lines.en: And the other is blushing like a maniac and seems to be more worried about being caught than someone else actually touching me.
lines.zh: 而另一个则脸红得像疯了一样，比起别人真的摸我，她似乎更担心被人撞见。

lines.en: : The meat has come!
lines.zh: : 肉来了！

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro17
: The meat has come!~
lines.zh: : 肉来了！~

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro18
: Wait, already? But she didn’t even...
lines.zh: : 等等，已经好了？可她连……

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro19
: Hehehehe...feast your eyes upon the magnificence that is the Queen of Spiders!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……尽情瞻仰蛛后的壮丽吧！

lines.en: : I informed you pitiful humans of my skills, and yet you continued to doubt me!
lines.zh: : 我已经向你们这些可怜的人类宣告过我的本事，可你们还是继续怀疑我！

lines.en: : The man is mine! The meat has come!
lines.zh: : 这个男人是我的！肉来了！

lines.en: : Ha...hahaha...the meat...has come...
lines.zh: : 哈……哈哈哈……肉……来了……

lines.en: : Hahah...haha...hah...hah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……哈哈……哈……哈……

lines.en: : Kill me.
lines.zh: : 杀了我吧。

lines.en: : This...is a bit of a shock.
lines.zh: : 这……有点冲击。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro20
: Your enormous breasts can not compete with my meat-handling abilities.
lines.zh: : 你那对巨乳可没法跟我处理肉的本事相比。

lines.en: : Can you call it something else, please?
lines.zh: : 你能换个说法吗，拜托？

lines.en: : The meat...has come...
: Well, now that that’s out of the way...Kaori, this is Futaba. Futaba, this is Kaori.
lines.zh: : 好了，既然这件事已经过去了……Kaori，这是 Futaba。Futaba，这是 Kaori。

lines.en: : Yes...she introduced herself earlier when we ordered...
lines.zh: : 是的……我们点单的时候她已经自我介绍过了……

lines.en: : Before I was made aware of how frequently she...handles your meat.
lines.zh: : 那时候我还不知道她……处理你的肉有多频繁。

lines.en: : Didn’t you just ask her to stop saying that?
lines.zh: : 你不是刚刚才让她别这么说的吗？

lines.en: : I honestly don’t even care anymore. I’m going right to sleep when I get home.
lines.zh: : 说实话我已经不在乎了。回家我就直接睡。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m pretty sure Rin is too.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我敢说 Rin 也是。

lines.en: : The meat...
: It came...
lines.zh: : 它来了……

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro21
: Yes it did, Rin.
lines.zh: : 是啊，它来了，Rin。

lines.en: : Yes it did.
lines.zh: : 它确实来了。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro22
: Friend!
lines.zh: : 朋友！

lines.en: : Did I do a good job?
lines.zh: : 我做得好吗？

lines.en: : You did a very good job, Kaori. You just need to work on how you make the other girls feel.
lines.zh: : 你做得非常好，Kaori。你需要改进的是让其他女孩感受如何这件事。

lines.en: : But you are my friend.
lines.zh: : 可你是我的朋友啊。

lines.en: : I’m their friend too. And their teacher.
lines.zh: : 我也是她们的朋友。还有她们的老师。

lines.en: : I understand. But you are my friend.
lines.zh: : 我明白。但你是我的朋友。

lines.en: : Is there something about having multiple friends that confuses you?
lines.zh: : 拥有多个朋友这件事，有什么让你困惑的地方吗？

lines.en: : There are many things that confuse me. Humans are strange.
lines.zh: : 让我困惑的事情有很多。人类真奇怪。

lines.en: : I just don’t want you to get too many friends and forget about me.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想你交太多朋友，然后就把我忘了。

lines.en: Oh no.
lines.zh: 哦不。

lines.en: I think my heart might have just...felt something.
lines.zh: 我觉得我的心刚刚……感觉到了什么。

lines.en: I didn’t realize it could do that.
lines.zh: 我都不知道它还能这样。

lines.en: : I’m not going to forget about you if I get more friends, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 就算我交了更多朋友，我也不会忘了你的，Kaori。

lines.en: : Actually, I’m pretty sure it wouldn’t be possible to forget someone as...unique as you in the first place.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我敢说像你这么……独特的人，本来就忘不掉。

lines.en: : Will trusting your words make me a better friend?
lines.zh: : 相信你的话，能让我成为一个更好的朋友吗？

lines.en: : I think that’s how it normally works, yes.
lines.zh: : 我想通常是这样的，是的。

lines.en: : Then I will do as you tell me.
lines.zh: : 那我就听你的。

lines.en: : But the second you demand I remove my clothes, I draw a circle.
lines.zh: : 但你一要求我脱衣服，我就会画一个圈。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro23
: Okay, I’m back.
lines.zh: : 好了，我回来了。

lines.en: : I believe the phrase you’re looking for is “Draw the line,” Kaori. And I’m not going to demand that you remove your clothes.
lines.zh: : Kaori，你想说的那句话应该是“划清界限”。而且我不会要求你脱衣服。

lines.en: : Good. Because your eyes ignited like fire when cute-skull-girl informed you of my instant gram.
lines.zh: : 很好。因为当那个可爱骷髅女孩告诉你我的 instant gram 时，你的眼睛像着了火一样。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro24
: BRB DYING AGAIN. KAORI CALLED ME CUTE.
lines.zh: : 我又要去死一死了，马上回。KAORI 说我可爱。

lines.en: : I still don’t understand why you set that account up if you were just going to delete it.
lines.zh: : 我还是不明白，你既然要删掉那个账号，当初为什么要注册？

lines.en: : I do not understand why you like hot meat sandwiches so much, but I do not try to change you.
lines.zh: : 我不明白你为什么那么喜欢热肉三明治，但我也没想改变你。

lines.en: : I enjoy you the way you are! Seemingly normal and slightly kind! And good at selling humans!
lines.zh: : 我就喜欢你现在的样子！看起来很正常，还有点善良！而且很会贩卖人类！

lines.en: : This may come in handy!
lines.zh: : 这说不定会派上用场！

lines.en: : I’m not good at selling- Wait, why would that ever come in handy?
lines.zh: : 我可不擅长贩卖——等等，那玩意儿什么时候会派上用场？

lines.en: : You will have to tell me. You are the experienced one.
lines.zh: : 那得由你来告诉我。你才是经验丰富的那个。

lines.en: : I just serve food and beverages.
lines.zh: : 我只是提供食物和饮料而已。

lines.en: Wait a second.
lines.zh: 等等。

lines.en: Food and beverages...
lines.zh: 食物和饮料……

lines.en: I was just thinking about Kaori earlier when I told Sara and Haruka about the “two and a half bartenders” I know.
lines.zh: 我跟 Sara 和 Haruka 说“两个半调酒师”的时候，其实刚刚才想到过 Kaori。

lines.en: Maybe they’ll be okay with receiving half of a bartender after all?
lines.zh: 也许她们其实可以接受半个调酒师？

lines.en: : Kaori, what are you doing tonight?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你今晚有什么安排？

lines.en: : Counting the rocks outside of my apartment. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 数我公寓外面的石头。你为什么问这个？

lines.en: : I was wondering if-
lines.zh: : 我在想你——

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : I was wondering if you’d want to come work at a bar.
lines.zh: : 我在想你愿不愿意来一家酒吧上班。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro25
: But I already work at a bar. Wouldn’t that be a...conflict of insect?
lines.zh: : 可我本来就在酒吧上班。那不是会……昆虫冲突吗？

lines.en: : Conflict of interest. And yes, I guess it kind of would be.
lines.zh: : 是利益冲突。而且是的，我想大概的确会。

lines.en: : But you work at multiple restaurants, so I don’t see what the big deal is.
lines.zh: : 可你本来就在好几家餐厅打工，所以我不觉得有什么大不了的。

lines.en: : It would just be for tonight. A friend of mine is having a Halloween party and needs someone to cover the counter.
lines.zh: : 就只是今晚。我一个朋友要办万圣节派对，需要有人顶吧台。

lines.en: : But I already told you that you can’t have any more friends.
lines.zh: : 可我说过了，你不能再交更多朋友了。

lines.en: : Didn’t we move past that?
lines.zh: : 我们不是已经跨过那件事了吗？

lines.en: : Oh, yes. We did. I accept your apology.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我们跨过了。我接受你的道歉。

lines.en: : You’re the one who is supposed to- Actually, never mind. Can you do it or not? I kind of told them I’d find someone to help.
lines.zh: : 该道歉的明明是——算了，当我没说。你到底能不能来？我跟她们说了会找人帮忙的。

lines.en: : Can you first explain what a Halloween party is? This is not a combination of words that I am familiar with.
lines.zh: : 你能不能先解释一下什么是万圣节派对？我不熟悉这个词的组合。

lines.en: : It’s just...a party for Halloween.
lines.zh: : 就是……万圣节的派对。

lines.en: : What is a ‘Halloween?’
lines.zh: : “万圣节”是什么？

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro26
: Halloween is like...an event where people dress up in costumes and get drunk and...eat and stuff.
lines.zh: : 万圣节就是……一个活动，大家穿上装扮、喝醉、然后……吃东西什么的。

lines.en: : Costumes? Why would they do that?
lines.zh: : 装扮？他们为什么要那样做？

lines.en: : I think it’s something about...celebrating the dead? Maybe?
lines.zh: : 我猜是跟……纪念死者有关？大概吧？

lines.en: : Why would we celebrate the dead? They are dead. They can not dance or consume dizzy-drinks.
lines.zh: : 为什么要纪念死者？他们都已经死了。他们既不会跳舞，也不能喝让人晕乎乎的饮料。

lines.en: : Where did you find this girl?
lines.zh: : 你从哪儿找到这个女孩的？

lines.en: : Is she even human?
lines.zh: : 她到底是不是人类啊？

lines.en: : I honestly haven’t figured that out yet.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我到现在也没搞清楚。

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro27
: Uhh...could I get a little help here?
lines.zh: : 呃……能有人来帮帮我吗？

lines.en: : Friend, what is so special about dead people? What is the need to celebrate them?
lines.zh: : 朋友，死人有什么特别的？有什么必要纪念他们？

lines.en: : Do I need to acquire a costume to work at this bar?
lines.zh: : 我要在这家酒吧上班的话，需要弄一套装扮吗？

lines.en: : I’m just going to answer the last question because the first two are a little too heavy for me.
lines.zh: : 我就只回答最后一个问题吧，前两个对我来说有点太沉重了。

lines.en: : You don’t need a costume. You just have to grab beers out of the cooler and pour glasses of wine.
lines.zh: : 你不需要装扮。只要从冷藏柜里拿啤酒、倒葡萄酒就行。

lines.en: : I can accomplish these tasks.
lines.zh: : 这些任务我能完成。

lines.en: : But I ask for one thing in return.
lines.zh: : 但作为交换，我要一样东西。

lines.en: : If it’s to be paid, I’m pretty sure the bar-owner is going to handle that.
lines.zh: : 如果是报酬的话，我敢说酒吧老板会处理的。

lines.en: : I require no money.
lines.zh: : 我不需要钱。

lines.en: : But I would like to go for a walk with you.
lines.zh: : 但我想和你一起散步。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, yeah. That’s easy enough. I can do that.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，好啊。这很容易。我可以。

lines.en: : When?
lines.zh: : 什么时候？

lines.en: scene rinfutababistro28
: In seventeen minutes and twenty-three seconds when I get off of work.
lines.zh: : 十七分二十三秒后，我下班的时候。

lines.en: : Why do you know the exact amount of time?
lines.zh: : 你为什么知道得这么精确？

lines.en: : I know many specific things!
lines.zh: : 我知道很多具体的东西！

lines.en: : Like how many threads are in my bed sheets! And how many calories are in a pint of frozen milk-sweets!
lines.zh: : 比如我的床单上有多少根线！还有一品脱冷冻甜奶里有多少卡路里！

lines.en: : Ice cream. And those are things that are printed on the containers they come in.
lines.zh: : 那是冰淇淋。而且那些东西就印在包装上。

lines.en: : Will you walk with me or will you betray my trust?
lines.zh: : 你会陪我散步，还是会辜负我的信任？

lines.en: : Sure, Kaori. I will wait the seventeen minutes and-
lines.zh: : 当然，Kaori。我会等那十七分钟，然后——

lines.en: : Sixteen now.
lines.zh: : 现在剩十六分钟了。

lines.en: : I will wait the sixteen minutes and go for a walk with you.
lines.zh: : 我会等这十六分钟，然后和你一起去散步。

lines.en: scene black
Kaori smiles and pushes my burger (That I apparently have to eat now) closer to me before running back into the bistro.
lines.zh: Kaori 笑了笑，把我的汉堡（看起来我现在非吃不可）往我这边推了推，然后跑回了餐馆里。

lines.en: Futaba and Rin both glare at me with extremely confused looks on their faces before sighing to themselves and remembering that I will willingly spend time with any female despite their...curiosities.
lines.zh: Futaba 和 Rin 都用极其困惑的表情瞪着我，随后各自叹了口气，想起我不管对方有多……古怪，都心甘情愿地跟任何女性待在一起。

lines.en: Actually, it’s possible that Rin was only sighing due to jealousy. But Futaba was definitely sighing out of pure exhaustion.
lines.zh: 其实，Rin 叹气可能只是出于嫉妒。但 Futaba 叹气绝对是因为纯粹的疲惫。

lines.en: I can’t blame her, though.
lines.zh: 不过我也不能怪她。

lines.en: Just being around Kaori is enough to tire most people out.
lines.zh: 光是待在 Kaori 身边，就足以把大多数人累垮。

lines.en: Which is exactly why I close my eyes and take several deep breaths as I step away from the table with Rin and Futaba.
lines.zh: 正因如此，当我和 Rin、Futaba 一起离开桌子时，我闭上眼睛深呼吸了好几次。

lines.en: From here on out, the day is only going to get more tiring.
lines.zh: 从现在开始，这一天只会越来越累。

lines.en: But I guess that’s just the tradeoff you get in exchange for time alone with an adorable, probably-human (???) girl.
lines.zh: 不过我想，这就是能和一个可爱、大概算是人类（？？？）的女孩单独相处所付出的代价吧。
